## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `sundial-{{TAG}}-setup.exe` | **Recommended.** Installer: no admin rights needed, adds a Start menu entry, upgrades in place |
| `sundial-{{TAG}}-x86_64-windows.exe` | Portable exe, no install. Run it from anywhere |
| `sundial-{{TAG}}-x86_64-windows.zip` | Portable exe + README |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for the files above |

> **Note:** Sundial isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Upgrading? Just run the new setup. It closes Sundial, replaces it, and keeps your history.
